title: What Healing Cities Is
definition: Healing Cities: cities designed around recovery, rest and care.
description:
Healing Cities — Signature Edition: cities designed around recovery, rest and care. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature healing hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: clinic districts rethought, calm transit rebuilt, therapeutic design reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the garden blocks ambition that defines the Signature line.

title: The Signature Vision: Healing Cities
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Healing Cities.
description:
The Signature vision of Healing Cities does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature healing hulls program, charter one: master clinic districts at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale calm transit manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate therapeutic design systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Healing Cities becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: The healing hulls Grid
definition: The healing hulls Grid: a load-bearing component of Healing Cities.
description:
The urban backbone: power, water, data and logistics woven into one clinic districts grid that the healing hulls district runs on.

In the Healing Cities architecture, the healing hulls grid is load-bearing: without it the healing hulls fails outright — Healing Cities stops being Healing Cities at all. Builders sequence this piece early because every other component assumes it works. In the Signature architecture this piece is designed first-class, not bolted on.

Maturity varies: some deployments of this piece exist today in simpler forms, while the full Healing Cities-grade version remains a research target. The readiness estimator in this database scores it honestly.

t: 2030 — The first healing hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first healing hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Healing Cities roadmap.
description:
The first healing hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its clinic districts grid and calm transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the clinic districts results have to replicate outside the lab, calm transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and therapeutic design operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed clinic districts demonstrations, calm transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting therapeutic design uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

Depends on: clinic districts, calm transit, therapeutic design.

title: Readiness Estimator: Healing Cities
definition: Estimates Healing Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Healing Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a healing hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Healing Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Healing Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Healing Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 85854 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where clinic districts monitoring, calm transit redundancy, or therapeutic design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Healing Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Healing Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Healing Cities — cities designed around recovery, rest and care.

Phase 1 — Prove (clinic districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (calm transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (therapeutic design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (garden blocks): healing hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and urban core-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
